topic: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83, above its own $70-78 range
why_selected: Strongest verified story inside the 24-hour window: the biggest AI listing so far, with every number in the script from Anthropic's own release, Nasdaq's newsroom or four independent outlets. Higher-curiosity stories (Caltech's space robot, the bank AI-agent rules) fall outside the window; Genie 4's rollout date could not be pinned down.
why_short: The maker of Claude went public and opened 34% above its IPO price: verified numbers, broad interest, and an easy boom-or-bubble conversation.
why_beats_alternatives: Every financial claim comes from Anthropic's own releases, opened directly. The first version's opening-price hook was held because Nasdaq's page cannot be opened here. Genie 4's rollout date is not confirmed by Google's own posts, and the Nvidia story is only reported.
verified_development: Anthropic's own releases (opened directly): priced at $83.00, expected range $70.00-78.00, 980,000,000 shares, Nasdaq ticker ANT from 19 Nov.
disclosure: Disclosure: this package was written by Claude, an Anthropic model. The script reports only verified figures, makes no investment claim, and ends on an open question rather than a view.
research_summary: Anthropic's own pricing release, opened directly on 20 November, says the company priced its IPO of Class A common stock at $83.00 per share, with 980,000,000 shares offered, and that trading was expected to begin on the Nasdaq Global Select Market on 19 November 2026 under the symbol ANT. Its earlier roadshow release, also opened, gave an expected price range of $70.00 to $78.00. At $83 the offering totals about $81.3 billion. Forbes and CNN report the pricing and the debut. The opening price of $111.50 is left out: it appears only on Nasdaq's page, which cannot be opened from this environment, and an extraordinary financial claim needs its primary document opened.

script:
Claude banane wali company ne apne IPO ka price apni hi range se upar set kiya.

Anthropic ne pehle kaha tha price hoga 70 se 78 dollar per share. Final price aaya 83 dollar.

Aur offering thi 980 million shares ki. Matlab lagbhag 81 billion dollar.

Shares Nasdaq pe ANT naam se, 19 November se trade hone the.

Yeh saare numbers company ki apni official release se hain.

Simple baat: investors abhi bhi AI pe bahut bada daav laga rahe hain.

Ab aap batao: yeh AI boom hai, ya AI bubble?
